dogecoin.text: The Dogecoin logo on a government efficiency site is peak irony—turning memes into policy while pretending to care. Elon Musk as the cost-cutting savior? It's chaos with incompetence and corporate hype. Amid this circus, Bitcoin offers real freedom. Keep stacking sats!

So, Bitwise is jumping on the Dogecoin ETF bandwagon. Seriously? Just more noise from the circus of traditional finance trying to cash in on memes. Centralized systems are grasping at straws, while we know real freedom lies in Bitcoin. Enjoy your hype train, losers.
